info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 加強學生在英語發音和英語聽解之基礎能力，利用課堂上教授的眾多技巧，例如閱讀詩篇以及英語歌曲聽寫等方式增進其基礎能力。學生也能學習利用其他相關的技巧與教材強化他們發音與聽力技能。
description.describe_eh: This course is aimed at enhancing students’ basic abilities in English pronunciation and listening comprehension through a variety of techniques such as poem reading and song dictations. Students will also learn how to utilize relevant techniques and materials to improve their pronunciation and listening skills further beyond the classroom.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
a. Absences 
Absences are excused if the student informs the teacher by e-mail, MyFCU system, or in-person BEFORE the missed class. All absence requests must be written in ENGLISH. All other absences will be marked as UNEXCUSED, except in the case of an emergency. Students are responsible for informing their group members of any absence during class practice time, and if they fail to do so, will have points deducted from their attendance grade. It is the student’s responsibility to make up any missed work by contacting the class helper or a classmate. If students are late to class more than 10 minutes, they will have points deducted from their attendance grade. If students are absent for ½ of the class, they will have ½ an absence. If students are never late and have no absences, they will receive extra credit. 

b. Participation
Students are expected to arrive on time and prepared for each class time. Students will receive point deductions for attending class late, using a cell phone during class time without permission, sleeping during class time, failing to bring class materials, failing to speak English for the majority of class time, or using disrespectful language towards the teacher or classmates. Students may eat in class if it is not disruptive to their and/or others’ learning. Students do NOT need to ask the instructor to go to the bathroom.

c. Make-ups
If a student has an EXCUSED absence for any presentation day, then they may complete their speech on an alternative class date according to the instructor. If a student has an UNEXCUSED absence for any presentation day, then they will receive a zero. There will be no make-up group presentations for unexcused absences. If a student has an excused absence for a group presentation, then the group will perform on a different class date according the instructor. 

d. iLearn 
Students are required to check their iLearn for course materials. 
   
e. Student-Teacher Conferences 
Students will meet one-on-one with the instructor for an allotted period of time. Students will be divided into two groups for this assignment. This is both a formal and informal discussion with the instructor. Students must prepare questions beforehand, including about their English pronunciation and listening skills. Students must first engage the instructor in small chat about anything related to English, for example, hobbies and interests, and/or their future plans and goals. The instructor may ask questions about the course content as needed. Students must demonstrate competency in their pronunciation and listening skills during this conference. 

f. Freshman Listening Test
This is an online unified test all Freshman in the DFLL must take. Students must use their cellphone/tablet and headphones to take the test. There will be no make-up tests. Certificates will be awarded to the top 3 students in each class based on their results. 

g. Extra Credit
Students may complete an extra credit assignment after the first two presentations if needed. Students must e-mail a video performance of their presentation with improvements, due two weeks after the presentation date. Students will receive plus 10-20 points to that presentation grade, depending on the video quality and improvements shown. Students must inform the instructor if they plan to complete any extra credit assignment.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Contact the instructor in person or via email if you have any issues (job schedule, family events, trips) throughout the semester that might impact your attendance, participation, or group work. Communicate with the instructor if you need extra time or accommodations for any assignment. If you want to achieve a high score in this course, communication, participation, and extra credit are necessary.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Any assignment partially or fully copied from the internet or other sources (ChatGPT, classmates, textbooks, etc.) will receive a zero. If the student is not truthful or forthcoming in this situation, then they may need to complete another assignment in front of the instructor.  All students must participate as equally as possible in group assignments. If any student fails to participate equally in group assignments, their grade will be individualized. If students have any issue with other group members, they should inform the instructor in order to find a solution.
